items.title: A Technology Vision for Quantitative Trading
items.text:
Thomas Schmelzer, Jebel Quant Research — May 2026

Jebel Quant Research builds the tools and infrastructure for systematic trading teams — from data access and portfolio construction to live execution and repo management. This document sets out the thinking behind that work.

It covers the problems with the traditional research-to-production handover, the case for a shared environment, the kitchen analogy for team structure, and the role of containerisation, backtesting discipline, risk management and AI in a modern quant operation.
